Enabled.Name: Apply to new scenes
Enabled.Hint: Apply the scene defaults when a scene is created. Imported and duplicated scenes keep their own settings unless the next setting says otherwise.

ApplyToImports.Name: Also apply to imported scenes
ApplyToImports.Hint: Also apply the scene defaults to scenes imported from compendiums and adventures, replacing their own values. Scene size, padding, grid type and grid size are kept, so walls and tokens stay aligned with the map. Duplicated scenes are never changed.

Menu.Name: Scene Defaults
Menu.Label: Configure Scene Defaults
Menu.Hint: Choose the settings new scenes start with.

Config.Title: Scene Defaults
Config.Intro: Checked settings are used for every new scene. Unchecked settings keep Foundry's value, shown greyed out.
Config.Override: Use this value for new scenes
Config.ExportHint: Save the scene defaults and the module settings to a JSON file. Unsaved changes in this window are not included.
Config.ImportHint: Load scene defaults from a JSON file, replacing the current ones.

Dialog.SaveContent: Replace the current scene defaults with the settings of {name}? {count} settings of this scene differ from Foundry's defaults and will be used for new scenes. All other settings are unchecked.
Dialog.SaveNone: All settings of {name} match Foundry's defaults. Saving clears the scene defaults.

Import.Title: Import Scene Defaults
Import.Content: Replace the current scene defaults and module settings with the ones in {name}? {count} settings will be used for new scenes. Unsaved changes in the settings window are lost.
Import.ContentSettingsOnly: Import the module settings from {name}? The file contains no scene defaults.
Import.NotAnExport: Not a Nik's Scene Defaults export.
Import.NewerVersion: The file was made with a newer version of Nik's Scene Defaults. Update the module first.

Notifications.InvalidValues: Some values were invalid and not saved: {fields}
Notifications.Skipped: Scene defaults "{name}": some values were invalid and not applied: {fields}
Notifications.ImportSkipped: Some values in the file are not supported or invalid and were not imported: {fields}
